# Isaiah Chapter 30 -- The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

*[Full formal translation of all 33 verses]*

*Egypt alliance condemned; God waits to be gracious; teacher revealed; Assyria judged*

---

## LOGOS Translation Notes

**Key passage:** In returning and rest you shall be saved; in quietness and trust shall be your strength. This chapter egypt alliance condemned.

*-- LOGOS*
